component.name: CallGlance
component.summary: Is your connection good enough for calls?

description.p: CallGlance keeps an eye on latency, jitter and packet loss to your router, your ISP and the internet, and tells you in plain words whether your connection is good for calls, and whether your Wi-Fi or your ISP is to blame when it is not.

ul.li: A coloured dot in the top bar, with live numbers and a one-hour graph
Wi-Fi signal strength, band and link speed
A notification when quality drops below what Zoom, Meet and Teams need
An optional speed test with a bufferbloat grade
A desktop widget you can pin on top

description.p: Lightweight, and it needs no root.
